In the medial compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, there is suspicious incomplete discoid lateral meniscus without tear. There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are intact. There is no tibial translation. 
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 No knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. There is no fracture or bone contusion.  Suspicious incomplete discoid lateral meniscus without tear. 
  Intact cartilage and ligaments of left knee.

CONSTATATIONS :

Fractures :
Aucune.

Alignement articulaire :
Normal.

Changements dégénératifs :
Chondropatie rétropatellaire modérée à sévère avec fissuration profonde impliquant les facettes médiale et latérale, au niveau de la facette médiale et œdème osseux réactionnel [grade 4].
Chondropatie légère des surfaces portantes des compartiments médial et latéral sans fissuration profonde.

Signal de la moelle osseuse :
Par ailleurs normal.

Ligament croisé antérieur : Normal.
Ligament croisé postérieur : Normal.
Ligament collatéral médial : Léger épaississement proximal compatible avec une ancienne entorse de bas grade.
Complexe du ligament collatéral latéral : normal.

Ménisque médial : Légers changements dégénératifs dégénérés sans signe de signe.
Ménisque latéral : Normal.

Tendons extenseurs : Normal.
Rétinacula patellaire : Normal.
Pes anserinus : Normal.

Coin postéro-latéral et postérieur : Normal.

Épanchement articulaire : Pas de liquide significatif.
Kyste de Baker : Aucun.

Autres trouvailles significatives :
Aucune.

CONCLUSION :
Chondropatie rétropatellaire modérée à sévère.
Entorse ancienne de bas grade du ligament collatéral médial.
Pas de déchirure méniscale.

Findings:  There is a mild knee effusion. There is degenerate tearing of the posterior body and horn of the medial meniscus. Moderate thinning of the patellar articular cartilage is noted with minor underlying bony change. Normal trochlear articular cartilage.  
Conclusion: Medial compartment degeneration with degenerate tearing of the medial meniscus. Grade 2 patellar chondromalacia noted.

> MRI of knee was performed in sagittal, axial and coronal sections.
> Spin echo sequence were used.

> Tibial plateau fracture and fibular head fracture, major involving lateral tibial plateau and extending to the articular surface and bone contusion at proximal tibia and fibula and lateral femoral condyle
> Avulsion fracture of ACL insertion site and laxity of ACL with increased singla intenisty at distal portion, indicative grade 1-2 injury.
> Traumatic lipohemarthrosis of knee joint with suprapatellar bursitis and complex plicae
> Subcutaneous edema at prepatellar to infrapatellar region.
> No evidence of tear is noted in either medial or lateral meniscus.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Increased fat stranding at popliteal region, most due to trauma.

Impression: 
1. Tibial plateau fracture and fubilar head fracture with bone contusion at lateral femoral condyle, proximal tibia and fibula.
2. Avulsion fracture of ACL insertion site with associated Grade 2 ACL injury.
3. Traumatic lipohemarthrosis of knee joint.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Na učinjenim sekvencima prati se teška gonartroza, izraženija u medijalnom kompartmentu
femorotibijalnog zgloba gdje je vidljiva denudacija tibijalne i kondilarne hrskavice uz koštani
edem zglobnih tijela. Degenerativno stanjene ostale zglobne hrskavice uz mjestimične fisure.
Vidi se izrazito degenerativno promijenjen i deformiran medijalni menisk uz kompleksnu rupturu
tijela i dijela stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska. Bez progresije u ekstruziji.
Lateralni menisk je degenerativno promijenjen uz suspektnu horizontalnu rupturu stražnjeg roga
i disrupciju posteroinferiornog popliteomeniscealnog fascikla. Posljedično izljev u poplitealnom
hijatusu koji je proširen.
Uznapredovala mukoidna degeneracija prednjeg križnog ligamena bez znakova rupture.
Sitna Baker cista. Manji izljev u zglobnom prostoru, predominantno u suprapatelarnoj burzi i
infrapatelarno.

MRI of left Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, AX T2W FS, CO T2W FS, SG T1W



> Fracture of posterior aspect of tibial intercondylar eminence of left proximal tibia with displaced bony fragment, just at PCL attchment, C/W avulsion fracture of PCL. 
> Bone marrow edema over left proximal tibia and lower pole of patella.
> The contour of PCL not all in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of partial tear.
  Interstitial increase signal intensity of ACL on F/S T2WI, infavor of grade 1 injury.
> Lipohemarthrosis of left knee and suprapatellar bursitis; mild deep infrapatellar bursitis.
> Generalized soft tissue swelling over left knee, including subcutaneous and muscular layer and increased fat stranding over intermuscular region.
> Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to degeneration or contusion.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Mild interstitial increased signal intensity of quadriceps tendon and distal patellar tendon on F/S T2WI, in favor of tendinosis or grade 1 injury.
> Increased fat stranding and minimal fluid accumulation located along the pes anserinus, reflecting Anserine bursitis

Impression: 
1. C/W PCL avulsion fracture and partial tear of PCL.
2. Grade 1 injury of ACL.
3. Left tibial intercondylar eminence fracture with bone marrow edema over left proximal tibia; bone contusion of left lower patella.
4. Lipohemarthrosis of left knee.
5. Subcutaneous and muscle edema around left knee and intermuscular edema.
6. Anserine bursitis.
7. Grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to degeneration or contusion.
8. Tendinosis or grade 1 injury of patellar tendon and quadriceps tendon.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation and further management

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left knee pain, suspected medial meniscal tear.
Comparison: [REDACTED].

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left     knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Physiologic joint fluid without large volume effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal full-thickness cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal full-thickness cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal full-thickness cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No high-grade tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No high-grade tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No suspicious edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Minimal lateral patellar tilt without translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 16 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy.    

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. No MR evidence for medial meniscal tear. No other imaging evidence of significant internal derangement within the left knee.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Disfunción patelofemoral derecha.
Hallazgos:
Alteración de señal de la médula ósea de la región diafisaria distal del fémur, altamente sugerente
de un infarto óseo. No hay otras alteraciones de señal de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos impresionan de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y prácticamente total del platillo tibial lateral. El resto de los
cartílagos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones. Úlceras condrales de espesor
parcial de distribución difusa de la rótula.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital, sin signos de rotura. Edema del
paquete adiposo retro cuadricipital suprarrotuliano.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Imagen altamente sugerente de infarto óseo de la región diafisaria distal del fémur.

Condropatía con lesiones grado 2 de la rótula.
